# Jump (`spells:jump`)
**Level 1 [Transmutation](../magic-schools/transmutation.md)** | **Casting Time:** Bonus Action | **Range:** Touch
**Components:** V, S, M (a grasshopper's hind leg) | **Duration:** 1 minute | **Classes:** [Druid](../classes/druid.md), [Ranger](../classes/ranger.md), [Sorcerer](../classes/sorcerer.md), [Wizard](../classes/wizard.md)

You touch a willing creature. Once on each of its turns until the spell ends, that creature can jump up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.
